review_description: Have had our solar installed for just over 3 months and got our first bill. The thing really works!! our bill is down from $370 to +$15 in credit. Usually I dont leave reviews but this really got me stoked. Thanks for actually delivering what was promised in the beginning.

They presented us with a panel design which help us a lot to understand what we would be getting and how it would look on our house.We went with the Sungrow inverter and their recommended Serphem panels as the price was on point for value. The communication was good and we were kept up to date on the whole process as we moved through to installation. Our installation was hassle free and smooth. The guys were really nice and helpful and all was finished in a day.Pretty happy with the overall experience and would recommend them to any of my friends.
